CommonHome.heroSubtext: Connex brings contacts, deals, conversations, and follow-ups into one CRM your whole team can work from.
CommonHome.contextBody: Companies and contacts connect to deals, activities, notes, and tasks, so your team can follow the work and its history.

company.label: Companies
company.heading: The context behind every customer.
company.body: Bring a company’s contacts, deals, and related history together. Keep profile details and ownership in one place so your team can pick up with context.

contacts.label: Contacts
contacts.heading: Know the people behind the company.
contacts.body: Keep contact details, company connections, and recorded conversations together. See who your team knows and what you last discussed.

deals.label: Deals
deals.heading: Move each deal forward.
deals.body: Track value, stage, and expected close date alongside the company and people involved. Keep related activities and next steps close to the deal.

activities.label: Activities
activities.heading: Keep the conversation in context.
activities.body: Record calls, emails, and meetings with their date and details. Link each activity to a contact or deal so the history is easy to follow.

notes.label: Notes
notes.heading: Save the details you’ll need again.
notes.body: Keep useful context beside a contact or deal, from meeting preparation to customer requirements. Choose private notes or share them with your workspace.

tasks.label: Tasks
tasks.heading: Give the next step a place.
tasks.body: Assign a follow-up, set a due date, and track it through to completion. Link tasks to a contact or deal so the next step stays with the work.

warmth.name: Warmth
warmth.heading: Read the relationship behind the record.
warmth.body: See how active each customer relationship is, with warmth based on the timing, frequency, and type of recorded interactions.
warmth.evidence: Open the activities, shared notes, and linked tasks behind each contact or company’s reading.
warmth.visualLabel: How recorded interactions contribute to warmth
warmth.noHistory: Relationships without recorded history show “No history.”

CommonHome.askHeading: An agentic assistant that moves work forward.
CommonHome.askBody: Find customer records, work through a deal, and create tasks, notes, or activities through conversation. Review proposed changes to deal stages and record owners before applying them.
CommonHome.askAvailability: AI availability depends on your workspace configuration and your organization’s AI provider. Answers can be incomplete; review the sources.
CommonHome.askPrompt: Check this renewal and create a follow-up task.
CommonHome.askFinding: The renewal is waiting on revised pricing.
CommonHome.askNextBody: I created a task to send the revised quote and agree on a new decision date.
CommonHome.mapHeading: See how your team’s relationships connect.
CommonHome.mapBody: Explore connections between your team, companies, and contacts. Search for a person or company and follow their recorded relationship history.
CommonHome.workflowBody: Choose a trigger, set conditions, and connect actions. Review a recipe with your team before enabling it.
CommonHome.workflowRecipe: Workflow example: route a won deal
CommonHome.workflowReview: Recipes start turned off. Review who the workflow runs as and what it changes before enabling it. Creating a handoff task does not complete the handoff.
CommonHome.attentionBody: Radar surfaces cooling relationships and deal risk. Introductions reveals connections worth exploring, with recorded evidence behind each suggestion.
CommonHome.attention_cooling_why: Five weeks without a recorded interaction since the August 7 review. The renewal conversation needs a follow-up.
CommonHome.attention_cooling_limit: An unrecorded conversation cannot update the reading. Check with the owner before following up.
CommonHome.attention_risk_why: The August 30 close date is 12 days overdue. The ¥8,400,000 renewal is still in Negotiating.
CommonHome.attention_risk_next: Agree on a new close date.
CommonHome.attention_risk_limit: An overdue date is a reason to review the deal, not proof that it will be lost.
CommonHome.attention_introduction_why: Aya’s August 21 call records a working relationship with Rina in Finance. Misaki can ask Aya about an introduction.
CommonHome.attention_introduction_next: Ask your teammate about an introduction.
CommonHome.attention_introduction_limit: A recorded connection supports a possible route. It does not guarantee an introduction or imply consent.
CommonHome.source_review_body: Misaki recorded a meeting with Mari about the annual renewal. Mari requested a revised quote before continuing the discussion. No later interaction with Mari is recorded as of September 11.
CommonHome.source_pricing_body: Email logged by Misaki: Mari asked for separate prices for the two service options so Procurement could compare them.
CommonHome.source_introduction_body: Aya logged a call with Rina about next quarter’s planning at Kitagawa Industrial. This records their working relationship; the call does not record a conversation with Mari or an agreement to an introduction.
CommonHome.source_close_body: The renewal is worth ¥8,400,000 and remains in Negotiating. Its expected close was August 30. At the September 11 snapshot, that date is 12 days overdue.
CommonHome.teamHeading: Keep the work and its history together.
CommonHome.teamBody: From the first deal to the next handover, keep each step connected to the customer.

deals.heading: Move the deal forward.
deals.body: Track each deal through your pipeline, with its owner, value, and next steps close at hand.

quotes.heading: Turn the deal into a quote.
quotes.body: Generate a quote from deal information. Review the document and apply your team’s approval controls before finalizing it.

progress.heading: See how the work is progressing.
progress.body: Review trends in Analytics and bring findings together in Reports to share with your team.

handover.heading: Pass on the work, with its context.
handover.body: Change the record owner while keeping recorded activity and ownership history together, so the next person can pick up with context.

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.body: All CRM features included. Choose the capacity and service your team needs.
pricing.allFeatures: Every plan includes the complete CRM, including Ask Connex, Workflows, relationship intelligence, quotes, and reporting. Capacity, company-managed SSO, and service levels differ.
pricing.aiNote: Ask Connex requires AI configuration and the appropriate permissions. Free has a small monthly allowance; Pro has a larger organization-wide pool that grows with paid seats, with administrator-approved top-ups. Enterprise uses a contracted allowance or customer-funded AI, depending on deployment.

free.name: Free
free.body: For getting your customer work organized.

pro.name: Pro
pro.body: For teams building their customer relationships.

highlights.ask: AI pool grows with paid seats

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.body: For organizations with specific identity, hosting, and support needs.

highlights.hosting: Shared cloud, Silo or on-premises options

pricing.poolingNote: Your Pro subscription belongs to your organization. Its seats, combined record allowance, and AI pool are shared across your organization’s own workspaces. Each full member counts once, even across multiple workspaces.
pricing.subscriptionNote: Pro includes two full-member seats, with a fixed charge per additional seat. Expand record capacity while staying on Pro.
pricing.usageNote: Storage, automation/API throughput, sending, and AI consumption have separate usage allowances, even though the same CRM tools are available on every plan.
pricing.serviceNote: Pro support covers product setup and troubleshooting. Enterprise software, deployment arrangements, support scope, and operator responsibilities are specified in the contract; Silo and on-premises options are quoted separately.

CommonHome.startHeading: Start with the customers you know.
CommonHome.stepCaptureBody: Bring in a CSV or add your first records. You can import interaction history once the related contacts exist.
CommonHome.stepUnderstandBody: Connect deals, notes, and tasks to customers. Give each next step a clear owner.
CommonHome.stepActBody: Record conversations and progress as you work. Give the next person the context to continue.
CommonHome.startNote: Everyday CRM work is useful from the start. Richer relationship evidence builds as your team records interactions; Connex can only read what has been recorded.
CommonHome.faqJaQ: Can our team use Japanese and English?
CommonHome.faqJaA: Yes. Japanese and English are supported throughout the interface. Each member can choose their language.
CommonHome.faqAiA: AI availability depends on workspace configuration. Proposed changes to existing records wait for you to apply them. While answering, Connex may immediately add an activity, task, note, or tag; it announces these additions and they are reversible. Check the answer and its sources before relying on it.
CommonHome.faqDataQ: How do we control access and data?
CommonHome.faqDataA: Workspace roles control access, with audit history and tools for retention and data requests. Connex supports cloud and self-hosted deployments. The details of data handling and privacy commitments are in the privacy policy; we do not claim a privacy-law certification.
CommonHome.metaDescription: Bring contacts, deals, conversations, and follow-ups into one CRM. Explore Ask Connex, Map, Workflows, and relationship intelligence for your team.
CommonHome.mapVisualLabel: Your workspace sits at the center, connected to its members. Each member connects to a client company, which connects to its contacts. Two branches illustrate the hierarchy.
CommonHome.workflowDiagramLabel: After a deal is won, check its value. High-value deals create a handoff task; other deals log an activity. The highlighted path shows the Yes branch.

AskConnex.turnInternalError: Something went wrong on our side while writing this answer. Ask again, and tell an administrator if it keeps happening.
AskConnex.turnUnreadableAnswer: The answer came back in a shape Connex couldn't read, so none of it was kept. Ask again, or reword the question.
AskConnex.turnStalled: The assistant kept re-reading the same records without getting any further. Ask again, or reword the question.
AskConnex.turnRanOutOfTime: This answer ran out of time before it finished. Ask again — or ask for a smaller slice if it keeps happening.
AskConnex.turnImageUnsupported: This assistant model can’t read images. Remove the image from the context above, or choose an image-capable model.
AskConnex.budgetExhausted: Your organization's daily AI limit has been reached. Ask the same question again later.
AskConnex.capacityExhausted: There is no AI capacity left for this request right now. Ask the same question again later.
AskConnex.toolResultBudgetExhausted: This answer needed more relationship data than it could hold at once. Try a narrower set of records or a shorter date range.
AskConnex.skillBudgetExceeded: This answer found what it needed but ran out of room to write it up. Ask it again, or ask a more specific question.
AskConnex.toolOutsideSkillAuthority: Ask Connex couldn't complete this request.
AskConnex.workspaceDisabled: Ask Connex is disabled for this workspace. A workspace administrator can enable it again.
AskConnex.contextWindowTooSmall: The AI model this organization uses can't take in enough at once for Ask Connex to work well. An organization administrator can switch to a more capable model.
AskConnex.accessRevoked: Your access to something this answer was reading changed while it was being written, so the answer was stopped and not kept.
AskConnex.restrictionsChanged: What this workspace allows AI to read changed while this answer was being written, so the answer was stopped and not kept.
AskConnex.partialAnswer: Unfinished answer — this is as far as the assistant got before it stopped.
